ItemConfig.Hint:
📖 Trigger Config Guide (Click to expand)

1. Basic Modes
• On Use / Attack / Damage: Auto-triggers via System Hooks.
• Keyword (Any / Roll): Triggers if a specific word exists.
• Dice Check: Inspects specific die values.
  └ Enter #(Index) and Val(Target). (See orange numbers in Inspector)

2. Special Mode (Advanced Formula)
Create complex conditions using JavaScript syntax.

[Operators]
• == : Equal
• != : Not Equal
• >= : Greater or Equal
• && : AND (Both true)
• || : OR (Either true)

[Variables]
• d : Array of die results (e.g. d[0] is the 1st die)
• t : Total sum of the roll
• flavor : Item name or chat text

[Examples]
• Fabula Ultima Critical:
d[0] == d[1] && d[0] >= 6
• Fumble (Snake Eyes):
d[0] == 1 && d[1] == 1
• Complex (Total >= 20 OR contains 'Finisher'):
t >= 20 || flavor.includes('Finisher')

InitialSetup.Title: Cinematic Cut-ins Initial Setup
InitialSetup.Description: Create and test your first actor cut-in.

Purpose.Title: Build one cut-in first
Purpose.Content:
This guide opens the Control Panel and walks through one actor cut-in. Nothing is saved automatically.

You can click the highlighted controls as you go, then use the Tour buttons if you want to move manually.

OpenActors.Title: Start from Actors
OpenActors.Content: The Actors tab is where personal cut-ins begin. The guide has opened it for you.

ChooseActor.Title: Click an actor row
ChooseActor.Content: Click an actor row to expand it. If this list is empty, create or import an actor first, then start the guide again.

OpenConfig.Title: Open Active Config
OpenConfig.Content: Click Active Config. This opens the editor for that actor's cut-in settings.

NamePreset.Title: Name the preset
NamePreset.Content: Use this field for a preset name you will recognize later. For a first test, something like Opening Cut-in is enough.

VisualTab.Title: Choose the look
VisualTab.Content: Click Visual. Add an image or video, choose a theme, then adjust the actor position if needed.

TextTab.Title: Set the text
TextTab.Content: Click Text. Set the main line and subtitle that will appear during the cut-in.

TestPlay.Title: Test locally
TestPlay.Content: Click Test. This plays the current cut-in only on your client, so you can check the result before saving.

Save.Title: Save when it looks right
Save.Content: Click Save Configuration when you are happy with the preview and local test. This is the step that writes the actor settings.

Triggers.Title: Add automation later
Triggers.Content: The Triggers tab connects this cut-in to attacks, chat rolls, resource changes, conditions, or turn timing. Save a working cut-in before adding trigger rules.

Finish.Title: First setup path
Finish.Content:
Your first path is: pick an actor, open Active Config, set image and text, test locally, save, then add triggers only if you want automation.

All-Out, Scenes, and reusable Styles are easier to use after one actor cut-in works.

2. Special Mode (Advanced Formula)
Create complex conditions using JavaScript syntax.

[Operators]

• >= : Greater or Equal
• && : AND (Both true)
• || : OR (Either true)

[Variables]
• d : Array of die results (e.g. d[0] is the 1st die)

[Examples]
• Fabula Ultima Critical:
d[0] == d[1] && d[0] >= 6
